# Steve Jobs on the importance of getting tools into people’s hands, IDCA, 1983

**Source**: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NQCqjT8rERw

**Transcribed**: 2025-12-26 16:16

---

**[Steve Jobs]**: Yeah, but see, the reason most of the people are at Apple is because they had intrinsic job satisfaction at their prior jobs, except when their stuff got done, the company screwed it up before it got out the door.

And what people really want to do, I'm convinced people really want to make things and get them out there and see people using them. And when you walk into a classroom and it's full of Apple IIs or something, it gives you a really good feeling to see these kids using them.

And if you design the greatest thing and it never gets out the door, you just sort of feel like you've blown some of the best time of your life, you know.
It's wasted.
